title: BHOC Veterinary Product | Biological Hemoglobin Oxygen Carrier
description: Explore the BHOC Veterinary product direction, a Biological Hemoglobin Oxygen Carrier platform for controlled oxygen delivery and veterinary research.
heading: A Biological Hemoglobin Oxygen Carrier platform.
lead: BHOC is a veterinary and multi-species development direction within Precision Oxygen Therapeutics.

profile.title: Controlled oxygen delivery beyond the red-cell system.
paragraphs: BHOC means Biological Hemoglobin Oxygen Carrier. It is a cell-free hemoglobin platform intended for immediate, controlled microvascular and tissue-level oxygenation while endogenous erythropoiesis recovers.

The intended profile is donor-independent, compatible across blood types and designed for practical room-temperature logistics. It is an oxygen-delivery platform, not a replacement for the wider biological functions of blood.

objectives.title: Immediate oxygen delivery
objectives.text: Support oxygen transport when anemia or blood loss limits oxygen-carrying capacity.

objectives.title: Donor-independent logistics
objectives.text: A development profile that does not depend on donor matching or crossmatching.

objectives.title: Room-temperature stability
objectives.text: Long shelf life and practical handling are core product-development objectives.

objectives.title: Cell-free architecture
objectives.text: Designed to be endotoxin-free and free of red-cell antigens, with species-specific evidence still required.

boundary.title: Product objectives are not regulatory approval.
boundary.text: BHOC development requires product-specific and species-specific evidence for formulation, dosing, safety and efficacy. Historical HBOC and Oxyglobin evidence is presented separately in the Evidence section.
